graphs.name: Teal & Orange
graphs.description: Cinematic blockbuster grade: teal shadows, warm skin and highlights, punchy contrast.

graphs.name: Vintage Film
graphs.description: Faded 70s print: warm cast, lifted blacks, soft highlights, muted colour, grain and vignette.

graphs.name: Noir
graphs.description: High-contrast black & white with bright skin, dark skies, grain and a heavy vignette.

graphs.name: Comic Pop
graphs.description: Pop-art comic: boosted colour, flat cel shading, ink outlines and halftone dots.

graphs.name: Dreamy Glow
graphs.description: Soft, airy and bright: glowing highlights, lifted shadows, gentle warmth and pastel colour.

graphs.name: Cyberpunk Neon
graphs.description: Night-city neon: cold blue shadows, magenta highlights, pink-shifted warm tones and glow.

graphs.name: Bleach Bypass
graphs.description: Gritty silver-retained film look: desaturated, metallic, high contrast.

graphs.name: Cross Process
graphs.description: Slide film in the wrong chemicals: yellow-green highlights, blue shadows, saturated and contrasty.

graphs.name: Tilt-Shift Miniature
graphs.description: Makes real scenes look like tiny models: sharp focus band, blurred top and bottom, toy-like colour. Move “Focus Y” per photo.

graphs.name: Pencil Sketch
graphs.description: Graphite drawing on warm paper: traced edges with soft shading.

graphs.name: Golden Hour
graphs.description: Late-afternoon sun: warm light, glowing highlights, opened shadows and rich colour.

graphs.name: Faux Infrared
graphs.description: Black & white infrared: glowing white foliage, near-black skies, dreamy halation.

graphs.name: Matrix Code
graphs.description: The green-tinted world of the 1999 film: green cast, crushed cool shadows, cel-shaded ink edges and optional falling code rain.

graphs.name: Dune Desert
graphs.description: Arrakis: burnt-orange monochrome palette, bleached skies, matte lifted blacks, heat-haze glow and grain.

graphs.name: Barbie Dreamhouse
graphs.description: Candy-coloured plastic fantastic: pink-shifted reds, magenta highlights, pastel brights, soft glow and a pink wash.

graphs.name: Cyberpunk Night City
graphs.description: Neon dystopia: acid-yellow highlights, cyan shadows, crushed greens, hard contrast, neon bloom and CRT scanlines.

graphs.name: Procedural · Plasma
graphs.description: No image needed: four sine waves summed over pixel position, mapped through a Colour Ramp. Change “Time” to animate, “Scale” to zoom. Open with Edit to see it on the procedural canvas.

graphs.name: Procedural · Stained Glass
graphs.description: No image needed: Voronoi cells give each pane a random colour, Voronoi “distance to edge” draws the lead lines, noise adds glass texture and a radial gradient adds back-light.

graphs.name: Procedural · Synthwave Sunset
graphs.description: No image needed: sky from a Colour Ramp on Y, a circle-mask sun cut by stripes, fractal-noise mountains, and a perspective grid floor built from maths.

graphs.name: Mask · Spotlight
graphs.description: Shape masking: a feathered Circle Mask keeps the subject bright and warm while the rest falls into dark, desaturated shadow. Move X / Y / Radius per photo.

graphs.name: Mask · Colour Pop
graphs.description: A mask built from maths instead of shapes: Separate HSV → hue distance → Map Range gives a per-pixel mask that keeps one colour and turns the rest black & white. Hue: 0 red, 0.08 orange, 0.16 yellow, 0.33 green, 0.55 cyan, 0.66 blue, 0.83 magenta.

graphs.name: Mask · Hexagon Frame
graphs.description: Polygon Mask framing: the photo inside a regular polygon on a coloured card. Sides, size and frame colour are per-image parameters (RGB Colour nodes are exposed too).

graphs.name: Converter · Duotone Map
graphs.description: Image → RGB to BW → Colour Ramp: brightness re-mapped through a gradient (Spotify-style duotone). Swap the ramp colours to taste.

graphs.name: Batch · Auto Enhance
graphs.description: One-click fix for a whole shoot: per-image auto levels and auto exposure (each photo measured on the GPU), recovered highlights, opened shadows, vibrance and capture sharpening.

graphs.name: Batch · Bright & Airy (Wedding)
graphs.description: Light and romantic: brighter exposure, soft highlights, open shadows, warm skin, pastel greens and a light matte.

graphs.name: Batch · Real Estate Interior
graphs.description: Bright, even interiors: auto exposure per room, strong shadow lift and highlight recovery (windows), neutral-cool white balance, clean vibrance and crisp detail.

graphs.name: Batch · Landscape + Grad ND
graphs.description: Punchy landscapes with a virtual graduated ND filter: deeper blue skies, richer foliage, local contrast, and a feathered Rectangle Mask darkening the sky down to the “Horizon”.

graphs.name: Batch · Portrait Soft Skin
graphs.description: Flattering portraits: a hue mask finds skin tones and blends in a soft blur only there (“Smoothing”), then warmth, gentle shadow lift and sharpening for the eyes.

graphs.name: Batch · Classic B&W Portrait
graphs.description: Timeless monochrome: skin-friendly black & white mix, rich contrast, deep blacks, fine grain and a subtle vignette.

graphs.name: Batch · Product on White
graphs.description: E-commerce catalogue: auto levels, a bright exposure that pushes the background to clean white, neutral colour and crisp detail – consistent across a whole product shoot.

graphs.name: Batch · Low-Light Rescue
graphs.description: Dim events and indoor shots: strong per-image auto exposure, lifted shadows, edge-preserving noise reduction (“Denoise”) and light sharpening.
